item.description:
Degrees

  • M.A. Urban and Regional Planning University Of California Irvine
  • Ph.D. Urban and Environmental Planning and Policy University Of California Irvine

Interests

Teaching

  • I design and teach courses examining how urban and environmental planning intersect with community development, social movements, and food systems.

Research

  • I am a community (re)builder researching and supporting community-led planning and grassroots governance systems. My research agenda aims to improve structural conditions for working families and frontline communities.
